blocks.task_summary: Find P(94.6 < H < 98.1) given P(H < 94.6) = 0.288 and P(H > 98.1) = 0.434, using the complement rule that total probability sums to 1.

evidence.basis: recognizing probabilities sum to 1 (M1); P(94.6 < X < 98.1) = 0.278 A1

blocks.task_summary: Find the mean m and standard deviation s of the normal distribution using inverse normal values from P(H < 94.6) = 0.288 and P(H > 98.1) = 0.434, then solve the resulting system of equations.
method_path: Set up equations: μ − 0.559σ = 94.6 and μ + 0.166σ = 98.1
Solve system via GDC to obtain μ ≈ 97.3, σ ≈ 4.82
accepted_alternatives: METHOD 2: Find z-scores first using inverse normal on 0.288 and 1−0.434, yielding z₁ ≈ −0.559, z₂ ≈ 0.166; then set up (94.6−μ)/σ = −0.559 and (98.1−μ)/σ = 0.166; solve to obtain μ ≈ 97.3, σ ≈ 4.82.

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: recognizing the need to use inverse normal with 0.288, (1−0.434) or 0.434 (M1); invNorm(0.288) = −0.559..., invNorm(1−0.434) = 0.166...; μ+σ·invNorm(0.288)=94.6, μ+σ·invNorm(1−0.434)=98.1 (A1)(A1); attempt to solve (M1); μ=97.3, σ=4.82 A1. METHOD 2: use of inverse normal to find at least one z-score (M1); z₁=−0.559..., z₂=0.166...; (94.6−μ)/σ=−0.559..., (98.1−μ)/σ=0.166... (A1)(A1); attempt to solve (M1); μ=97.3, σ=4.82 A1.

blocks.task_summary: (i) Find P(X = 34) where X ~ B(100, 0.434) models the number of plants ready to harvest. (ii) Find conditional probability P(X = 34 | X < 49).
method_path: Apply conditional probability: P(X = 34 | X < 49) = P(X = 34) / P(X < 49) ≈ 0.0157

evidence.basis: (i) recognition of Binomial distribution (M1); X ~ B(100,0.434); P(X=34)=0.0133198... = 0.0133 A1. (ii) P(X<49)=0.848218... (A1); recognition of conditional probability (M1); P(X=34|X<49)=P(X=34)/P(X<49)=0.0133198.../0.848218...=0.0157 A1.
